description: This file defines the BackwardCompatible class, a strategy for handling grain interface version compatibility within the Orleans framework, treating all interface versions as compatible only with equal or lower versions.

classes.name: BackwardCompatible
classes.description: A compatibility strategy class that enforces backward compatibility for grain interface versions, allowing only versions less than or equal to the requested version.

methods.name: Singleton
methods.description: A static property that provides a singleton instance of the BackwardCompatible class.
